findings.description: Creszentia Haas was born 28 May 1830 at Durbach, Amt Offenburg, Baden, the daughter of Mathias Haas and Maria Anna Schmieder.
supporting_sources: Germany, Baden, Archdiocese of Freiburg im Breisgau, Catholic Church Records, 1463-1931 - entry for Crescentia Haas, born 28 May 1830, baptized at Durbach, parents Mathias Haas and Maria Anna Schmieder (ark:/61903/1:1:QP3D-5ZR5)

Germany, Baden, Archdiocese of Freiburg im Breisgau, Catholic Church Records, 1463-1931 - marriage of Franz Klausmann and Kreszentia Haas, 12 Dec 1859 at Durbach, naming her parents Matthias Haas and Maria Anna Schmieder; identity corroboration that she survived past Genofeva's 1855 birth (ark:/61903/1:1:WXK5-XQ6Z)

findings.description: Creszentia Haas was christened 29 May 1830 at Durbach, Amt Offenburg, Baden.
supporting_sources: Germany, Births and Baptisms, 1558-1898 - entry for Crescentia Haas, christened 29 May 1830 at Durbach, Offenburg, Baden, parents Mathias Haas and Maria Anna Schmieder (ark:/61903/1:1:C4GZ-FYZM)

findings.description: The hinted 25/26 May 1835 birth and christening at Lichtental, Amt Baden, is a different Creszentia Haas - the daughter of Mathias Haas and M. Anna Steinel - and must not be asserted of the subject.
supporting_sources: Germany, Births and Baptisms, 1558-1898 - entry for Creszentia Haas, born 25 May 1835 and christened 26 May 1835 at Lichtental, Amt Baden, parents Mathias Haas and M. Anna Steinel (ark:/61903/1:1:NJB1-3BM)

Germany, Births and Baptisms, 1558-1898 - second entry for the same Lichtental family at Oberbeuern, parents Mathias Haas and M Anna Steinel, showing it is a real but distinct family (ark:/61903/1:1:7MF8-6C3Z)
